_meta.scenario: web-search internals THROW mid-pipeline (cache read failure): route catch, NO evidence, NO web_meta
_meta.semantics: getCachedQuery throws inside runWebResearch after the web:searching stage frame: the route's try/catch logs and CONTINUES — no evidence block is injected, no web_meta frame, no error frame; stage frames emitted BEFORE the throw survive verbatim. This pins the route-side non-fatal contract independently of the starved case (03), which never throws. The upstream forward is a clean single call with the unmodified messages array.

env.web_mock_boundary: cache(miss-only), net(scripted pages, fetchUrl=null), engines(scripted SERP)
